Bihar MLC Election Results 2026:prashant kishor (Prashant Kishor) ki 'jan suraj parti' (Jan Suraaj ) ne bihar vidhan parishad (uchch sadan) men bhi apni jagah bana li hai. darbhanga shikshak nirvachan kshetr ka chunav jitkar suresh prasad ray jansuraj ke pahle emaelsi (MLC) ban gae hain. jan suraj ummidvar ne darbhanga shikshak nirvachan kshetr se chunav jit liya hai. suresh prasad ray ne kangres ke bare neta aur maujuda emaelsi madan mohan jha ko 324 voton se hara diya.
